threat_event: Production secrets stolen from the laptop (malicious development package or information-stealing malware) and used to copy the production database and photo storage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hosting API token, database password, and API keys in a plaintext .env file; long-lived CI token never rotated; database open to any address; no alerting on bulk reads
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 production database and photos; SYS-09 laptop
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(n); FTC Start with Security 3); Customer DPA; Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)
existing_controls: Laptop full-disk encryption; MFA on the hosting console
treatment_plan: Move secrets into the password manager secrets feature and delete the .env file; rotate every secret; scoped deploy token rotated every 90 days; database allow list; monthly audit log review; P08 runbook

threat_event: Takeover of the hosting or source repository account through phishing or a stolen browser session
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner is the only administrator; browser sessions stay signed in for weeks on a laptop also used for personal browsing; no alerting on new sign-ins
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 hosting account; SYS-02 repository and CI
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant security keys for hosting, repository, email, and registrar; shorter session lifetime; separate browser profile for administration; sign-in alerts on; security awareness course

threat_event: Shared super-admin login is misused or exposed through the support contractor (contractor device compromise, reuse after the contract ends)
threat_source: Freelance support contractor or attacker using the contractor's device
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contractor signs in to the admin console as the owner; password only; admin console can export any subscriber's data and logs nothing; contractor device unmanaged
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 admin console; all subscriber data
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 2, 6); Customer DPA
existing_controls: Confidentiality clause in the freelance agreement
treatment_plan: Named support role with MFA and no export right; admin action log; change the super-admin password; security terms in the contractor agreement

threat_event: Application flaw lets one subscriber's staff see or change another subscriber's clients (broken tenant isolation)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Isolation enforced only by one shared query helper; no automated isolation tests; no security testing
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 web application; all subscriber data
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 5, 7); Customer DPA
existing_controls: Code review by the owner of every change
treatment_plan: Automated cross-tenant tests in CI that fail the build; database row-level security as a second layer; annual outside test of authorization

threat_event: Known vulnerability in an outdated library is exploited in the web application
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 untriaged dependency alerts (2 high severity); no scan of the running application
existing_controls: Dependency alerts on; monthly framework updates
treatment_plan: Fix the 2 high-severity alerts now; monthly triage with fix times (high 14 days, others 30 days); quarterly web application scan

threat_event: Owner-developer is suddenly unavailable (illness or injury) or loses the only phone, so nobody can operate, restore, or hand back subscriber data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single person holds every role, credential, and second factor; no recovery codes offline; no standby developer
regulatory_driver: N51-R01; Customer DPA (export and deletion commitments)
existing_controls: Self-service client export in the product
treatment_plan: Sealed emergency access kit with the owner's attorney (recovery codes, spare security key, one-page access sheet); password manager emergency access; standby developer arrangement under NDA (P05)

threat_event: A failed deployment, migration, or account compromise destroys production data and the restore takes longer than the BIA allows
threat_source: Owner-developer error; attacker with the API token
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups only in the production account; photos not backed up; one restore test (2026-08-27); 14-hour outage on 2026-03-11
regulatory_driver: N51-R01; website statement "automatic backups every day"
treatment_plan: Nightly encrypted copy outside the production account; photo versioning; written restore steps; restore test every August and before risky migrations

threat_event: Hosting provider regional outage lasts longer than a working day
existing_controls: Provider availability commitments (SOC 2 report, P09); status page; 6 a.m. day digest emails
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Keep the day digest emails and the status page on a separate service

threat_event: AI model provider keeps or uses subscribers' client messages and service notes beyond the service, contrary to the company's promises
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No DPA; provider not on the public sub-processor list; no written confirmation of no-training and retention settings; full service notes in prompts
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 AI model API; Smart Replies (BP-02)
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (deception; FTC Start with Security 8); Customer DPA (sub-processor notice)
treatment_plan: Sign the provider's DPA with no-training and retention terms; add it to the sub-processor list with 14 days' notice; send only the fields needed (P10)

threat_event: Smart Replies sends a wrong, unsuitable, or private reply to an end client (hallucinated prices or times, private service notes repeated, prompt injection in a client message)
threat_source: Generative AI output error or a malicious client message
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Auto-send turned on by 6 beta subscribers; drafts include service notes; no output filtering; no accuracy sampling
existing_controls: Staff review drafts when auto-send is off; AI drafts labeled in the inbox
treatment_plan: Turn off auto-send; keep service notes out of prompts unless the subscriber opts in; output checks for prices and times; monthly sample review (P10)

threat_event: FTC deception exposure because public and questionnaire statements do not match practice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: "We never share your data with third parties", "99.9% uptime", and "never used to train AI" are not accurate; questionnaire answers claim individual admin accounts
treatment_plan: Correct the website security page and release note now; review all public statements and the questionnaire document every quarter against P07 results

threat_event: Domain registrar account takeover redirects booking links and company email (DNS hijack)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Registrar account has a password only; no registrar lock
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-08 domain and DNS; BP-01 and BP-02
existing_controls: Unique password in the password manager
treatment_plan: Turn on registrar MFA and transfer lock; add DNS change alerts

threat_event: A security incident is noticed late or a contract or legal notice deadline is missed (48-hour and 72-hour DPA notices; Florida 10-day agent notice)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, contact list, or breach counsel before 2026-09-25; no log review; no list of subscriber security contacts
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Data Breach Response); Customer DPA; Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook; identify breach counsel; build the subscriber security contact list with the two 48-hour customers flagged; walk through the runbook

threat_event: Old or unneeded copies of subscriber data enlarge any breach (31 closed accounts kept; full local copy on the laptop; client data in error reports)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention schedule; DPA promises deletion within 30 days of closure; development uses real data
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 1); Customer DPA (30-day deletion)
treatment_plan: Delete the 31 closed accounts; automated deletion 30 days after closure; delete the laptop copy and use synthetic data; error report scrubbing

threat_event: Hurricane or long power and internet outage at the home office stops the owner from working for several days
affected_asset_or_process: Owner's ability to support and deploy (BP-03, BP-04); the platform itself is cloud-hosted
existing_controls: Platform runs in the cloud; phone hotspot; laptop travels with the owner
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Charge devices and download the runbook before a storm watch; post a status notice
